- Committed the HA support boundary cleanup as 87094ad (Flatten HA support process output boundary).
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it updated the Ralph task files, sent the task-finished email, and printed the same benign rm warning because .ralph/current_task.txt was absent.
- Next after any future context cut: continue from the newly switched task; note that unrelated dirty files remain in the worktree, including a separately staged bug file and Ralph/progress/skill files not touched by this change.

- Read prior progress entry and saw the last recorded task already completed with commit 87094ad and task switch.
- Loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill instructions to follow the one-boundary-collapse workflow.
- Next: inspect tests/ha/support and its callers, pick one concrete fake boundary, then refactor and verify with lint/tests before commit and task switch.

- Mapped tests/ha/support and chose one concrete fake boundary: SqlObserver was a one-method wrapper used only through HarnessShared::sql().
- Collapsed that wrapper by turning observer/sql.rs into a direct execute(materialized_dir, ...) function, removed HarnessShared::sql(), and updated the single caller in steps/mod.rs.
- Next: run formatting/checks, focused cargo nextest for the touched HA support tests, then commit and task switch.

- make check passed after collapsing the SqlObserver wrapper.
- Focused nextest world tests passed; one first attempt to run a feature scenario used the wrong nextest filter and returned zero tests, so the exact selector still needs to be resolved.
- Verified a separate issue in write_convergence: connection and task results are discarded with let _ = ..., so a bug task must be filed before finishing.

- make check passed, focused world nextest tests passed, and two ultra-long HA scenarios passed: stopped_replica and killed_primary_fails_over_and_recovers.
- Filed bug task .ralph/tasks/bugs/write-convergence-discards-member-worker-errors.md after confirming write_convergence discards errors/results.
- Next: commit only the SqlObserver boundary cleanup plus the new bug task, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Committed the HA support boundary cleanup and bug ticket as b36dd76 (Flatten HA support SQL observer boundary).
- The commit hook completed successfully, including docs lint/publish steps.
- Next: run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh, then report any remaining unrelated dirty files in the worktree.
